seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Frame-colour rule: floor 5, any other colour blocks; 4x4 blocks (10, armed 1) sorted by x = left/right, A3/A4 mirrored.
Move iff dest 4x4 in rows 1..62 all floor except own cells; active marker cell = 2x2 bbox grown by 1.
Click colour 9 = arm/switch (marker->11, blocks->1), colour 1 = disarm, else no-op; A5 no-op.
HUD zeros row 0 right-aligned + row 63 left-aligned, width 3(a+1)//7, a = actions incl. no-ops, continuity-gated.
Unconfirmed: stateless a fallback (largest a for bar width), A7, level completion.
